name: ShareLite: Zero-Bloat Social Sharing
author: Ashar

sections.description:
ShareLite is built on a simple philosophy: sharing buttons should not slow down your website. This plugin adds highly optimized, non-tracking share buttons for all major social networks, ensuring your site passes Core Web Vitals with flying colors.

It’s GDPR-safe, AMP-compatible, and fully responsive.

Features:
* Inline and floating share buttons.
* Extensive list of networks: X, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, and many more.
* Optional “Native Share” API for a seamless mobile experience.
* SVG icons for crisp display on all devices (no icon fonts or images).
* Absolutely no tracking scripts or cookies.
* Customizable styles: Control button size, shape, and colors from the settings.
* Passes Core Web Vitals and is safe for GDPR/privacy regulations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sharelite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > ShareLite to configure your buttons.
sections.faq:
Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. ShareLite does not load any external scripts, does not use cookies, and does not track users in any way. It is completely privacy-safe.

Can I customize the button style?

Yes! The settings page allows you to control the button size, border-radius (for circles or squares), icon color, and background color.
